criteria.requirement: Add pendulum.business.BusinessCalendar immutable caller-supplied date holidays and weekday weekend policy, no downloads. Provide is_business_day, signed add_business_days, next_business_day(include_current=False), and signed half-open count. Zero addition preserves identity, nonbusiness starts count following eligible days, negatives reverse, Pendulum Date/DateTime use calendar-day add preserving type/timezone/wall clock. Freeze mutable inputs, reject all-seven weekend/invalid weekdays or datetime holiday objects. Existing ordinary date add remains unchanged; finite local synthetic dates only.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
